nbd938cee68.headline: ENBD REIT reports full-year net asset value of $180 million
nbd938cee68.summary: ENBD REIT reported a full-year net asset value of $180 million and a total property portfolio valued at $360 million.
nbd938cee68.why: ENBD REIT is a significant real estate investment trust in the UAE, and its asset valuation reflects market conditions and investor confidence in regional real estate.

n14a3bea6fd.headline: In-restaurant dining records strong recovery in UAE: Network International

n14a3bea6fd.why: Recovery in consumer spending in hospitality signals economic normalization and boosts related sectors in the UAE economy.
